description: The file is an HTML webpage for a database viewer interface, including embedded CSS styles and JavaScript for dynamic behaviors such as fetching database information, displaying data tables, and user interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and updates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by reloading all databases, resetting current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables and loads tables if expanded.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database from the server and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches data for a selected table and displays it in a formatted table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data into an HTML table with support for wide content.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for a cell based on its content, with support for objects and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses table cell content for viewing full data.
